ACME Bio Announces Positive Phase 3 Topline Results for ACM-101

Primary endpoint met with high statistical significance

BOSTON, Nov. 25, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- ACME Bio, Inc. (Nasdaq: ACMB) today announced positive topline results from its Phase 3 trial of ACM-101. The company plans to request a pre-NDA meeting and expects a PDUFA date in 2027.
